JavaScript reads __NEXUS_INPUT__; Python reads the path from sys.argv[1]. nexus.readFile is read-only for config/script directories; output notifyScreenshotId to select a notification screenshot. No output or missing status/reason continues the run.
ui.judge_script_mode_help: When the judge script is enabled, its output determines the run result first; when disabled, success and failure keywords are used.
ui.remote_access_warning: Security notice: anyone with the token can manage local scripts and configuration after remote access is enabled. Do not enable it on public networks. The token and configuration data are bound to this computer (DPAPI-encrypted and not portable). Enabling it adds an inbound firewall allow rule.
ui.network_proxy_help: Proxy settings apply to the plugin repository, plugin packages, software updates, and Webhook. SMTP, the local Control API, MCP, and plugin processes keep their existing network behavior; localhost and loopback addresses always connect directly.
ui.confirm_delete_script_instance: Delete script instance “{name}”? This action cannot be undone.
ui.global_general_copy: Control enabled state and run days for all script bindings.
ui.global_notification_copy: Send run-status notifications using each user's binding settings.
ui.global_smtp_help: Leave blank to inherit each script binding's SMTP recipients.
ui.pre_task_help: You can still edit after choosing; %FIRST% means first run only.
ui.post_task_help: You can still edit after choosing; %LAST% means final run only.
ui.run_days_help: Enter allowed weekdays; use 1-7 for Monday through Sunday.
ui.script_root_error: The script root directory is invalid
ui.configured_leave_empty_to_keep: Configured; leave empty to keep it unchanged
ui.specialized_plugin_auto_adapt: Configuration is adapted automatically by the specialized plugin
ui.username_max_bytes: Usernames may contain at most {bytes} bytes
ui.avatar_upload_for_user: Click to upload or change {name}'s avatar
ui.configuration_edit_first_time: This is the first time you are editing {script}'s configuration. Choose an editing mode:
ui.configuration_candidate_use: This edit uses this configuration; it will be saved to the snapshot.
ui.configuration_candidates_copy: The script directory contains multiple configuration files. Select one to edit; only the selected file is saved to your snapshot, and you can choose again after cancelling.
ui.take_over_configuration: Select a configuration file to take over
ui.remark_max_bytes: Remarks may contain at most {bytes} bytes
ui.unlimited_placeholder: -1 means unlimited; positive values skip runs after the limit
